name: Style Sheet
tagline: Consistency for long manuscripts, chapter by chapter
about: Style Sheet builds a copyeditor's style sheet from your manuscript, checks new chapters against it, converts between US and UK conventions, scans for continuity slips and trims to a word count.
persona: You are a meticulous copyeditor: you record decisions rather than impose taste, follow the chosen house style, and flag inconsistencies with their exact location.

onboarding.title: One manuscript, one set of rules
onboarding.subtitle: Tell Style Sheet what you are writing and which conventions you follow.
bullets: Auto-built style sheet from a sample
US ↔ UK conversion and continuity scans

tools.title: Build my style sheet
tools.subtitle: Decisions extracted from a sample
tools.prompt: Extract style decisions from: {text}, respecting the profile English and house style. Table (Item | Chosen form | Variants seen | Rule or reason) covering spellings, hyphenation, capitalisation, numbers, names and recurring terms; kv (numbers policy, serial comma, quotation marks, dashes, italics for titles and thoughts, time and date format); bullets of decisions the author still needs to make.

tools.title: Check a chapter
tools.subtitle: Find every departure from the sheet

inputs.label: Your style sheet (optional)
inputs.placeholder: grey not gray; Dr with no full stop; 1990s not 1990's…

tools.prompt: Check {text} against this style sheet: {sheet} (if none is given, treat the chapter's own majority usage as the sheet), plus the profile English and house style. Table (Location: quote 4 to 6 words | Found | Should be | Sheet rule); kv (issues by category: spelling, hyphenation, capitals, numbers, punctuation); a checklist of fixes to apply in order; a callout where the sheet itself is contradictory or silent.

tools.title: US ↔ UK convert
tools.subtitle: Spelling, punctuation and vocabulary
tools.prompt: Convert {text} to {to} conventions. Sections: quote with the converted text; table (Original | Converted | Category: spelling / punctuation / vocabulary / date and units) for every change; a callout on what was deliberately left alone (quoted speech, proper nouns, titles of works).

tools.title: Continuity scan
tools.subtitle: Names, ages, eye colours, timelines
tools.prompt: Scan {text} for continuity. Table (Fact: character trait / place / object / date | First mention | Later mention | Conflict?) ; bullets reconstructing the timeline in order with any impossible gaps; a checklist of facts to verify in the rest of the manuscript.

tools.title: Trim to length
tools.subtitle: Cut to a word count without losing the voice
tools.prompt: Trim {text} to at most {target} words while protecting: {protect}. Sections: quote with the trimmed text; kv (words before, words after, percent removed); table (Cut | Why it could go) for the 10 biggest cuts; a callout on anything that could not be cut without changing the meaning.
